def fetch_playlists(is_public):

# Select Spotify playlist long enough for today's workout (Thursday, duration 45 mins)
from datetime import datetime

# workout duration from already fetched note content
workout_duration_mins = 45
print('workout_duration_mins', workout_duration_mins)

sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password='IXSwolL')['access_token']

# fetch all playlists already known by ids from earlier step
playlist_ids = [179,180,181,182,183,184,185,186]

playlist_summaries=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_seconds = sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    total_mins = total_seconds/60
    playlist_summaries.append((pid, pl['title'], len(songs), total_mins, total_seconds))
    print(pid, pl['title'], 'songs', len(songs), 'total_mins', total_mins)

# pick smallest total_mins that meets requirement
candidates = [x for x in playlist_summaries if x[3] >= workout_duration_mins]
print('candidates', [(c[0], c[1], c[2], round(c[3],2)) for c in candidates])

chosen = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[3])[0] if candidates else sorted(playlist_summaries, key=lambda x: x[3], reverse=True)[0]
print('chosen', chosen)
